worldcombat.skill.octolock.summary: Send out a tentacle that seizes one foe and pins it where it stands; every round after that it squeezes again, lowering Defence and Sp. Def by one stage each. The hold is the user's to keep: leave the grip distance or fall, and the tentacle slackens.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.use.0: Wrap up a bulky target that has to be solved and feed it to your team
worldcombat.skill.octolock.use.1: Pin a foe heading for the exit right beside you
worldcombat.skill.octolock.use.2: Grind down a target's defences over a long standoff
worldcombat.skill.octolock.description.0: The tentacle reaches %1$s blocks to seize the target and holds for up to %2$s; if the user drifts more than %3$s blocks away or falls, the tentacle lets go.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.description.1: It squeezes every %1$s, lowering Defence and Sp. Def by 1 stage each time; and the squeeze count floats above the target.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.description.2: Wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cooldown %3$s; the target cannot move while held.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.option.on: Tight coil: squeezes more often (interval x0.75) and holds +1 block further; the cost is reach -1 block and cooldown x1.2 — a tighter, meaner hold, but closer and pricier.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.option.off: Loose coil: reaches further, throws faster and recharges sooner; the cost is a slower squeeze and an easier escape.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.timing: Reach %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP and cooldown %5$s from commit. The wind-up can be interrupted at no cost.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.growth.0: From level %1$s: the hold lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.preference.co: On (Tight coil): squeezes more often (interval x0.75) and holds +1 block further; the cost is reach -1 block and cooldown x1.2 — a tighter, meaner hold, but closer and pricier. Off (Loose coil): reaches further, throws faster and recharges sooner, but squeezes slower and is easier to escape.
worldcombat.skill.octolock.preference.ai: The partner only considers the hold while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it to melee, larger closes in from farther first.
On: targets at a higher health fraction rank higher (the hold is a grinding drain, not a finishing blow). Off: rank purely by the ordinary fight order.
